name: The Paper Lantern Jellyfish Bloom
description: An ocean bay where bioluminescent jellyfish are living paper lanterns -- translucent rice paper bells with ink-brush calligraphy tentacles. They pulse with haiku written in light, drifting in currents that carry poems between shores.
prompt: A tranquil bay at twilight. Thousands of jellyfish-lanterns: bells of handmade rice paper, glowing from within with warm candle-light. Tentacles are flowing ink-brush calligraphy strokes that rewrite themselves as they drift -- kanji, hangul, latin script, abstract marks. Each pulse illuminates a new haiku in light. Some lanterns are traditional round, others hexagonal, crane-shaped, lotus-shaped. They drift in coordinated currents forming readable verses across the water. Reflection doubles the poetry. Distant shore has stone lanterns matching the jellyfish. Magical realism, Japanese aesthetic (wabi-sabi), bioluminescence, calligraphy as living motion.
caption: Poetry that swims. 🏮🌊 Each pulse a new verse. Each tentacle a brushstroke rewriting itself. The tide carries haiku between shores. What would your jellyfish-lantern say?
